description: Fix Dashboard TUI 'Loop' header ghost-stacking by bounding the composed frame height to the pane rows so Ink reconciles in place.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed useWindowSize returns terminal {columns, rows} and Box accepts a numeric height prop measured in lines (rows) integrated with the Yoga flex layout, so a top-level height={rows} bound stabilizes the composed frame line count. No breaking change vs the current usage (columns is already destructured from the same hook).

userStories.title: Bound Dashboard composed frame height to pane rows to stop 'Loop' header ghosting
userStories.description: As a cam operator watching the live dashboard, I need the composed frame height bounded to the terminal pane rows so that Ink reconciles the frame in place instead of re-emitting it every steady same-width poll tick, which stacks the 'Loop' header once per tick.
acceptanceCriteria: rows is destructured from useWindowSize (today only columns is, src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:183) and the top-level Box (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:276) is given a fixed height={rows} so Ink's composed frame line count is stable and never exceeds the pane. [oracle: grep -q 'height={rows}' src/ui/Dashboard.tsx]

The width-gated makePollWidthClearer clear-on-width-change logic is left UNCHANGED and its tests pass unmodified: the describe('makePollWidthClearer (US-001)') block (test/dashboard.test.ts:1055-1112) is not touched or weakened. [oracle: ! (git diff main -- test/dashboard.test.ts | grep -q 'makePollWidthClearer')]
The makePollWidthClearer behavioral guarantee (no clear on steady same-width ticks, exactly one CURSOR.clear per width change) still holds. [oracle: bun test]

On steady same-width poll ticks with a frame taller than the pane, the 'Loop' header no longer stacks/ghosts because Ink reconciles in place; verified by rendering/exercising the dashboard, not by trusting the header comment or a passing snapshot alone. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The change is confined to src/ui, test/, and scripts/cam/; no sidecar, supervisor, or loop-executed code is touched. [oracle: ! (git diff --name-only main | grep -vqE '^(src/ui/|test/|scripts/cam/)')]

The dashboard screen renders correctly at the new height geometry via ink-testing-library; any toContain content assertions affected by the height bound are re-verified against the new geometry, never deleted or weakened to pass. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (destructure rows at line 183; add height={rows} to the top-level <Box flexDirection="column"> at line 276), possibly src/ui/Section.tsx if the heading needs geometry help. Do NOT implement arm (a) clear-every-tick: dropping the width guard re-opens CAM-306 (commit ac673e2d) full-viewport flicker and CAM-321 (083058f1) Warp scrollback churn and breaks 3 of 4 US-001 tests. Root cause: composed frame taller than the tmux pane on a same-width tick; SummaryPanel's conditional tokens/cost rows (Dashboard.tsx:477-493) are the variable-height culprit (StoriesSection is already windowed via computeWindow/STORIES_WINDOW; RecentSection bounded via RECENT_ENTRIES_COUNT=5). Ink useWindowSize returns {columns, rows}; Box height is measured in lines. Ink success/failure is the glyph, never divider color. Coherence: this is binary-executed TUI output, inert until the cam binary is rebuilt+reinstalled; the orchestrator rebuilds/relaunches the sidecar after ship. Universal lesson: a comment does not prove runtime behavior, render and look at the real output. Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for 'Dashboard'/'Ink'/'useWindowSize' before coding.
